name: Valerio Vignoli
title: University of Siena, Italy | Theodore Roosevelt Memorial Grant
bio: Valerio revised the taxonomy, ecology and biogeography of *Euscorpius* for his PhD. He visited the AMNH twice to revise the North American scorpion family Typhlochactidae. He also participated in AMNH trips to Benin, Costa Rica, Morocco, Guinea-Bissau and Senegal.
